title: Frequency reference source circuit and electronic device
abstract: Embodiments of the present disclosure provide a frequency reference source circuit and an electronic device. The frequency reference source circuit comprises a front-end circuit and a back-end circuit, wherein the front-end circuit comprises a current generating circuit, a resistor branch and a capacitor branch. The current generating circuit is configured to output a positive temperature coefficient current and a negative temperature coefficient current, and the resistor branch and the capacitor branch are configured to output a first voltage signal and a second voltage signal based on the positive temperature coefficient current and the negative temperature coefficient current, respectively; the back-end circuit is coupled to the front-end circuit and configured to modulate the first voltage signal and the second voltage signal to obtain a reference frequency output signal. The frequency reference source circuit can realize second-order temperature compensation of a reference frequency output signal.

title: Driving device for power semiconductor device
abstract: A driving apparatus for a power semiconductor device, comprising: the power amplifying circuit is used for outputting a driving signal subjected to power amplification to the power semiconductor device so as to control the running state of the power semiconductor device; the short circuit detection circuit is used for detecting the short circuit state of the power amplification circuit and generating a corresponding short circuit state signal according to the short circuit state; the control circuit is used for generating a corresponding control signal according to the short-circuit state signal and the received driving signal; wherein when the short-circuit state signal is a signal representing that the power amplifying circuit is short-circuited, the control circuit is configured to control the power amplifying circuit to change the level of the signal output by itself to zero. The device can rapidly and accurately identify whether the power amplification circuit is short-circuited, and can perform corresponding protection action under the condition that the power amplification circuit is short-circuited.

title: A/d converter fault detection device, power supply device comprising same, and a/d converter fault detection method
abstract: This A/D converter fault detection device comprises a second IC that includes: a second A/D converter for converting a second analog value, detected by a second reference terminal for acquiring the second analog value of a reference signal, into a second digital signal at a second resolution; and a second communication terminal that is connected to a first communication terminal to perform communication. A first IC can transmit, from a first communication terminal to a second communication terminal, a first digital signal obtained by subjecting a first analog value of a reference signal detected by a first reference terminal to A/D conversion by a first A/D converter and at a first resolution. The second IC compares the second digital signal, obtained by subjecting the second analog value of the reference signal detected by the second reference terminal to A/D conversion by the second A/D converter and at the second resolution, with the first digital signal received by the second communication terminal, and if the difference therebetween is greater than a prescribed reference value, determines that a fault has occurred.

title: Input/output protection circuit and circuit protection device
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of circuits, in particular to an input/output protection circuit and a circuit protection device. An input/output protection circuit comprises an isolation element, a switching element, an input protection unit and an output protection unit, wherein the isolation element is provided with an input end and an output end and is used for realizing electrical isolation between an input signal and an output signal in a photoelectric coupling mode, the switching element is connected with the input end of the isolation element and is used for controlling the working state of the isolation element, the input protection unit is used for limiting the voltage or the current of the input signal, and the output protection unit is connected with the output end of the isolation element and is used for carrying out current limiting protection on the output signal and providing a signal output port isolated by the isolation element. The scheme can realize the isolation protection of the circuit.

title: High-frequency power supply system
abstract: Provided is a technology for suppressing an increase in a reflected wave power (the same as a reflection coefficient) by an IMD. According to the present invention, a high-frequency power supply system providing a high-frequency power for a load accessed comprises: a bias power supply which outputs a bias power at a first frequency; a source power supply which outputs a source power at a second frequency which is higher than the first frequency; and a matching unit which includes an impedance matching circuit which acquires the bias power and the source power and acquires the matching of impedance on the source power supply side and the load side. The source power supply determines a delay set value showing a starting timing for processing fluctuations in the frequency for the source power, processes fluctuations in the frequency by using the relevant delay set value and the value of the first frequency, and outputs the source power with the fluctuated frequency to the matching unit.

title: Two-part epoxy based composition
abstract: This invention relates to a two-part epoxy based composition, comprising a first part comprising at least one epoxy resin; a second part comprising at least one epoxy resin curing agent, and at least one acrylamide compound containing a hydrogen atom bound to the nitrogen atom in the acrylamide structure. The two-part epoxy based composition according to the present invention exhibits excellent adhesion strength to low surface tension substrates, such as stainless steel and PVC.

title: Porous resin used to solid phase synthesis and preparation method therefor
abstract: A porous resin used to solid phase synthesis and a preparation method therefor, specifically being a porous resin having functional groups being an amino group or a hydroxyl group and a preparation method therefor. Using an olefin compound containing two cyano groups as a modified monomer, using a high internal phase emulsion as a pore-foaming agent, and performing suspension polymerization to prepare the porous resin. And then functionalizing the porous resin to obtain the porous resin having functional groups being an amino group or a hydroxyl group. Different from the existing preparation method, the modified monomer can make the distribution of the functional groups more uniform, and make the swelling degrees of the porous resin in different solvents close. The high internal phase emulsion pore-foaming agent can make the pore size distribution of the carrier narrower. The porous resin can be used as a solid phase synthesis carrier to prepare an oligonucleotide, and the use of the carrier is beneficial for improving the yield and purity of the oligonucleotide.

title: Modified polylactic acid plastic and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention provides modified polylactic acid plastic and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of modified plastic. The modified polylactic acid plastic is prepared from sodium dodecyl sulfate, alkyl amide carboxyl betaine modified nano clay, PLA and an antioxidant through premixing, melting, extrusion, cooling and granulating. According to the invention, the nano clay is modified by adopting the sodium dodecyl sulfate and alkylamide carboxyl betaine compound modifier, the hydrogen bond effect of the modified nano clay and PLA ester group is enhanced, and the interfacial binding force is improved, so that the modified PLA has good barrier property, mechanical property and shock resistance, and has good application prospect.

title: Polypyrrole coated MoS2/C composite material and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses polypyrrole-coated MoS 2 a/C composite material and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method of the composite material comprises the following steps: 1) dissolving sodium molybdate dihydrate and thiourea in ethanol, adding polyvinylpyrrolidone, stirring, placing in a high-pressure kettle, and reacting at 150 deg.C or higher to obtain the final product 2 C assembled hollow nanospheres; 2) get from MoS 2 And C, uniformly mixing the hollow nanospheres assembled by the/C and an oxidant, taking the obtained mixture as a raw material, taking pyrrole as a coating source, taking a high-pressure kettle as a reaction chamber, and carrying out heat preservation reaction under the condition that the mixture and the pyrrole are not in contact with each other under the heating condition or the non-heating condition to obtain the composite material. The composite material is in a hollow spherical shape and has excellent Li + Storage performance and reversible capacity, and the preparation method is simpler and more environment-friendly.

title: Nano rod-shaped vanadium tetrasulfide powder and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a method for preparing nano rod-shaped vanadium tetrasulfide powder, which comprises the following steps: (1) taking thioacetamide to dissolve in absolute ethyl alcohol, and stirring until the thioacetamide is completely dissolved to obtain a mixture A; (2) adding ammonium metavanadate into the mixture A, and stirring until the ammonium metavanadate is completely dissolved to obtain a mixture B; (3) dripping dilute hydrochloric acid into the mixture B under the stirring condition to form a transparent solution, so as to obtain a mixture C; (4) transferring the mixture C into a hydrothermal reaction kettle, and carrying out hydrothermal reaction for 24-25 h; (5) naturally cooling after the reaction is finished, centrifugally washing for a plurality of times, and drying in vacuum to obtain the nano rod-shaped vanadium tetrasulfide powder. The nano rod-shaped vanadium tetrasulfide prepared by the method has the advantages of higher specific capacity, excellent cycling stability, long service life and higher conductivity.

title: Improved structure of temperature and pressure reducer of condenser
abstract: The utility model discloses a condenser temperature and pressure reduction ware improves structure relates to condenser technical field. The utility model discloses a casing and transport pipe, the inner wall of casing from left to right is fixed with cooling tube, protection casing and throttle plate, and the upper end of the fixed atomising head of protection casing inner wall is fixed with the connecting pipe, the connecting pipe runs through the upper end of casing, the upper end of casing is fixed with the cooling water admission pipe, and the lower extreme of casing from left to right is fixed with cooling water discharge pipe and drain pipe in proper order, be fixed with the relief pressure valve on the transport pipe. Can carry the cooling tube with water through cooling water admission pipe and cooling water discharge pipe in, then utilize the temperature of hot transferability can tentatively reduce steam, then the water pump is pumped and is sent water to the atomising head blowout through the connecting pipe, and the temperature of steam can further be reduced to spun water, and two-stage cooling effect is better, later can tentatively reduce pressure through the throttle plate, further reduces pressure through the relief pressure valve afterwards, and two-stage decompression effect is all good.

title: Intelligent-control low-temperature air heat pump unit
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligently controlled low-temperature air heat pump unit, which belongs to the technical field of air heat pumps and comprises a shell, wherein an evaporator box is fixedly installed at the top of an inner cavity of the shell, an evaporator pipe is installed in the evaporator box, a water tank is fixedly installed at the bottom of the inner cavity of the shell, the evaporator pipe penetrates through the evaporator box and is fixedly connected with the water tank, a water inlet pipe is fixedly installed at one side of the water tank, an air inlet pipe is fixedly sleeved at one side of the shell, which is close to the water inlet pipe, the air inlet pipe is connected with the evaporator box, a rotating shaft is installed in the air inlet pipe, a fan is fixedly installed on the rotating shaft, a transmission mechanism is installed between the rotating shaft and the water inlet pipe, a dust screen is fixedly installed on the inner wall of one end, which is far away from the evaporator box, of the air inlet pipe, a cleaning mechanism is installed between the rotating shaft and the dust screen, and a water collecting mechanism is installed between the bottom of the evaporator box and the shell. Drive mechanism when the inlet tube flows into cold water, drive mechanism drives the pivot and rotates for fan work makes the air current pass through the evaporimeter case, thereby the evaporimeter pipe of being convenient for absorbs heat, and unit operation effect is guaranteed in the linkage of whole intelligence.

title: Compact air conditioner
abstract: The invention relates to a compact air conditioner, which comprises a shell, a micro compressor, a compressor driver, a condensation heat exchanger, a condensation fan, a filter, an expansion valve, an evaporation heat exchanger, an evaporation fan, a gas-liquid separator, a water pan, a first flow-limiting cover plate, a second flow-limiting cover plate, an air inlet pipe body and an air outlet pipe body, wherein the shell comprises a bottom plate, a protective cover, a flow-limiting cover and a flow guide cover; the condensation heat exchanger is arranged on the first support, the first flow-limiting cover plate is covered on the condensation heat exchanger, the condensation fan is arranged between the first flow-limiting cover plate and the protective cover and is communicated with the first flow-limiting cover plate in a butt joint mode, the evaporation heat exchanger is arranged on the second support, the second flow-limiting cover plate is covered on the evaporation heat exchanger, and the evaporation fan is arranged between the second flow-limiting cover plate and the flow-limiting cover and is communicated with the second flow-limiting cover plate in a butt joint mode. The invention has the advantages of compact structure, good use performance, high reliability, small volume, convenient use, large application range and the like.

title: Inlet and outlet pipe integrated vacuum pump
abstract: The utility model provides an air inlet and outlet pipe integrated vacuum pump, which comprises a box body, a main machine and an oil-gas separator, wherein the main machine and the oil-gas separator are arranged in the box body, the air inlet and outlet pipe are arranged in the top of the box body, a partition plate is arranged in the air inlet and outlet pipe, the partition plate divides the air inlet and outlet pipe into an air inlet pipe section and an air outlet pipe section which cannot be mutually communicated, an air outlet is arranged on the air inlet pipe section, the air inlet and the air outlet pipe section extend out of the top of the box body, an air inlet pipe is further arranged on the air inlet pipe section, the tail end of the air inlet pipe is provided with an air filter assembly, the air filter assembly is connected with the air inlet end of the main machine through an air inlet valve, the air outlet end of the main machine is connected with an oil-gas mixing inlet of the oil-gas separator through an oil-gas mixing pipe, the oil-gas separator is a double-cylinder type oil-gas separator, and the top of the double-cylinder oil-gas separator is provided with two outlets, and the two outlets are respectively communicated with the air outlet pipe section through two air pipes. The air inlet pipe and the two air outlet pipes are integrated on the air inlet and outlet pipe to form an integrated structure, so that the assembly is very convenient.

title: Gas heater two draw and penetrate side's pipe and combustor and water heater
abstract: The utility model discloses a gas water heater double-ejection square tube, a burner and a water heater, which are characterized in that the gas water heater double-ejection square tube comprises a square tube main body, wherein the square tube main body is provided with an air inlet main channel, a first gas cavity, a second gas cavity and a third gas cavity, and the second gas cavity and the third gas cavity are respectively arranged at two sides of the first gas cavity; a first gas channel is connected between the first gas cavity and the gas inlet main channel, a second gas channel is connected between the second gas cavity and the gas inlet main channel, and a third gas channel is connected between the third gas cavity and the gas inlet channel; a second section valve is arranged between the second fuel gas channel and the main air inlet channel, and a third section valve is arranged between the third fuel gas channel and the main air inlet channel; the three gas channels are mutually independent and connected in parallel on the gas main channel, so that the opening or closing of the sectional valve can not intercept or influence the gas pressure of other channels. The utility model discloses simple structure, easy dismounting.

title: Food processing effluent treatment plant
abstract: The utility model provides a food processing wastewater treatment device, which comprises a tank body, the middle position of the upper end of the tank body is fixedly connected with an inverted U-shaped plate, the middle position of the upper end of the inverted U-shaped plate is fixedly connected with a driving motor, the inside of the upper side of the tank body is fixedly connected with a fixed box which is transversely arranged, an output shaft of the driving motor penetrates through the inverted U-shaped plate and is rotatably connected with the upper end of the fixed box through a bearing, the left end of the fixed box is provided with a parallel surface of an arch-shaped collecting box with an upward opening and an arc surface of the arch-shaped collecting box is attached to the inner wall of the tank body, the parallel surface of the arch-shaped filter screen and the arc surface of the arch-shaped filter screen are attached to the inner wall of the tank body, the right end of the output shaft of the driving motor is provided with a flexible brush and is attached to the upper end of the arch-shaped filter screen, the design utilizes the flexible brush to effectively clean up impurities such as scum on the surface of the arch-shaped filter screen, prevent that arch filter screen mesh from blockking up, promote waste water filtration efficiency.

title: Fruit vegetables antistaling agent sprinkler
abstract: The utility model discloses a fruit and vegetable preservative spraying device which comprises a box body, wherein fruit and vegetable preservative is injected into the box body, a feeding hole is formed in the right side of the box body, a discharging hole is formed in the left side of the box body, a first conveying belt, a material turning plate and a second conveying belt are sequentially and fixedly arranged in the box body from right to left, and the material turning plate is of an arc-shaped structure and is located between the first conveying belt and the second conveying belt. In the utility model, fruits and vegetables enter the box body through the feed inlet, are pushed to the second conveying belt by the turning plate and are sent out by the discharge outlet, the preservative is sprayed to the surfaces of the fruits and vegetables by the atomizing spray heads, the automatic conveying and spraying of the preservative are carried out on the fruits and vegetables, time and labor are saved, the efficiency is improved, the fruits and vegetables are low, when the fruits and vegetables pass through the turning plate in the conveying process, the fruits and vegetables are turned over under the combined action of the turning plate and the spraying plate, and the atomizing spray heads on the spraying plate continuously spray the preservative to the surfaces of the fruits and vegetables, so that the preservative can be uniformly and comprehensively sprayed to the surfaces of the fruits and vegetables.

title: Solid-liquid separation device for kitchen waste
abstract: The utility model discloses a kitchen garbage solid-liquid separation equipment, including the box body, install down the sieve in the box body, be equipped with a plurality of sieve meshes on the sieve down, the box body is equipped with the pan feeding mouth including the top cap that is located sieve top down, the bottom plate that is located sieve below down, the bottom plate middle part is sunken formation infundibulate gradually down, and the delivery port has the cask through the pipe connection, the right side of box body is equipped with handles the pond, be equipped with on the sieve down and be used for sweeping into the lower sieve tooth of handling the pond with the solid matter on the sieve down, the right side of box body has the feed opening that the solid matter on the sieve down passes through under supplying. The utility model discloses a kitchen garbage solid-liquid separation equipment utilizes the sieve tooth to shift to the processing pond with remaining solid matter automatic on the screen cloth, has avoided the solid matter to pile up on the screen cloth and has influenced screen cloth filter effect, need not artifical long-term supervision. The device has the advantages of good solid-liquid separation effect, low labor cost and high automation degree.

title: Prevent yellow medicine throw isolated plant that material is unrestrained of material in-process dust diffusion
abstract: The utility model discloses a special device for preventing dust from diffusing and materials from scattering in the process of feeding xanthate, which relates to the technical field of material feeding. Therefore, firstly, the sealed feeding mechanism enables the xanthate to only enter the reaction kettle along the sealed bin in the flowing process, so that diffusion cannot occur, and pollution to the outside is avoided. And secondly, the air draft mechanism enables the xanthate diffused to the feeding end to be transferred to the feeding end, so that the xanthate is prevented from reaching the outside through the feeding end. Thirdly, the cutting mechanism omits manual cutting of the ton bag by workers, and further avoids contact between the workers and xanthate.

title: Portable sealed pickled Chinese cabbage fermentation box
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of food science and engineering, and discloses a portable sealed pickled Chinese cabbage fermentation box, which comprises a box body, wherein a slot is formed in the inner side wall of the box body, a box cover is arranged at the top of the box body, rectangular grooves are formed in the surface of the box cover, two cavities are respectively formed in the box cover, a closing component is arranged in each of the two cavities, a connecting pipe is installed on the surface of the box body, a mounting groove is formed in the inner side wall of the connecting pipe, a water outlet pipe is connected to the inner side wall of the mounting groove in a sliding mode, and a clamping groove is formed in the surface of the water outlet pipe. The portable sealed pickled Chinese cabbage fermentation box can be opened and closed by simply poking the L-shaped rotating block, complex operation is not needed, the lever type transmission design is more labor-saving in force application of hands, the operation can be easily performed by old people and children, the opening and closing process is accompanied by damping and buffering, noise generated by collision of parts is avoided, and meanwhile, the sealing performance in locking moment is ensured not to be influenced by impact.

title: Patient supports for medical treatments
abstract: A patient supporting device includes: a base; a positioner; a platform having a first end and a second end; and a controller; wherein the positioner is operable by the controller to place the platform at one of a first plurality of possible positions or at one of a second plurality of possible positions, wherein in any of the first plurality of possible positions, the second end of the platform is closer to one of a left side and a right side of a treatment machine; wherein in any of the second plurality of possible positions, the second end of the platform is closer to another one of the left side and the right side; and wherein a size of a first spatial region defined by the first plurality of possible positions is different from a size of a second spatial region defined by the second plurality of possible positions.

title: Restraint device and monitoring system
abstract: The invention discloses a restraint device and a monitoring system, which belong to the technical field of medical equipment and comprise a placing bag, a restraint assembly and a monitoring assembly, wherein the restraint assembly comprises a contraction bag, an elastic rope, a limiting ring, a connecting part, a fixing patch, a connecting belt and a patch, when a patient needs to be infused, the elastic rope can be pulled first to expand the contraction bag, so that the hand of the patient can pass through the contraction bag to enter the placing bag, the elastic rope can be pulled again to tighten the contraction bag, the restraint device can be prevented from falling off from the hand of the patient during infusion, the patch is covered on the fixing patch to further seal the contraction bag, the patient is limited by the monitoring assembly, the behavior of the patient is monitored, the agitation degree of the patient is prevented from exceeding a first calibration value, and the problem that the conventional device cannot be effectively restrained during infusion of the patient is solved.

title: Relocation module and methods for surgical equipment
abstract: Modules for housing electronic and electromechanical medical equipment including a system to measure and record administration of one or more IV medications or fluids for IV administration.

title: Supplementary element for a shockwave treatment device, a shockwave treatment device and a kit including such a supplementary element
abstract: A supplementary element (1) configured to be attached to a shockwave treatment device (5), producing shockwave for treating a treatment zone of a patient in operation, the supplementary element being configured to allow for the transferring shockwave produced by the treatment device (5) to the treatment zone when the supplementary element (1) is attached to the treatment device (5), the supplementary element (1) further comprising a treatment support section (20), being configured to contact a periphery region of the patient surrounding at least partially the treatment zone, the treatment support section (20) being configured to allow for holding in position on the treatment zone the treatment device (5) in operation.

title: External application traditional chinese medicine treatment device for traditional chinese medicine internal medicine
abstract: The invention discloses an externally applied traditional Chinese medicine treatment device for traditional Chinese medicine, which relates to the technical field of medical treatment, and comprises a main body cylinder, wherein the main body cylinder comprises a fixed cylinder block arranged on the main body cylinder, an external frame for being in butt joint with external posture adjusting equipment is arranged on the fixed cylinder block, a winding mechanism comprises an unwinding cylinder arranged on the rotating cylinder block, a traditional Chinese medicine compress for treating a patient is fixedly wound on the surface of the unwinding cylinder, the other end of the traditional Chinese medicine compress is connected with the winding cylinder, the rotating mechanism is driven by a moving mechanism to start rotating, the unwinding cylinder and the winding cylinder are driven by the rotating mechanism to synchronously rotate, so that winding and unwinding operation of the traditional Chinese medicine compress is completed, when the traditional Chinese medicine compress is operated to a position where hot compress is not applied, the external driving stops rotating at the moment, and then the extruding mechanism extrudes the traditional Chinese medicine compress to be close to the medicine compress position of the patient, so that the purpose of automatically switching the traditional Chinese medicine compress is achieved, a patient continues to perform a new-stage compress operation, and the compress efficiency is improved.

title: Remote operation and maintenance system of water environment quality monitoring equipment
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of water environment monitoring, and particularly provides a remote operation and maintenance system of water environment quality monitoring equipment, which comprises an alternate measurement and decoupling module, a mutual exclusion collaborative decision module, a hydraulic transient suppression and calibration reconstruction module and a physical mechanism mapping correction module. The method comprises the steps of obtaining signals through three sections of alternate measurement by an alternate measurement and decoupling module, decoupling an equivalent pollution film thickness and a probe body sensitivity attenuation coefficient based on a joint inversion model, generating a mutual exclusion regulation and control instruction according to the mutual exclusion regulation and control instruction by a mutual exclusion cooperative decision module, outputting a time sequence combination instruction of cleaning before calibration during mixed degradation, calculating delay time by a hydraulic transient suppression and calibration reconstruction module according to pipeline pressure attenuation data fitting hydraulic time constant to obtain a reconstruction calibration signal, and updating a fluid shear force mapping coefficient in the joint inversion model by a physical mechanism mapping correction module by combining the front and rear pollution film thicknesses and the hydraulic time constant. The invention realizes the physical separation of the abnormal root causes and the accurate mutual exclusion scheduling.

title: Sampling inspection device for detecting regional malodor pollution
abstract: The utility model relates to the field of air detection and discloses a spot inspection device for detecting malodor pollution in an area, which comprises a lower box body, wherein an upper box body is fixedly connected to the upper surface of the lower box body, a first partition plate is fixedly connected to the inner wall of the upper box body, a second partition plate is fixedly connected to the inner wall of the upper box body, a third partition plate is fixedly connected to the inner wall of the upper box body, a hole is formed in the center of the first partition plate in a penetrating mode, and a first air inlet pipe is fixedly connected to the inner wall of the hole. According to the utility model, through the cylinder above the second partition board, the sealing block connected with the output end of the cylinder slides in the first air inlet pipe to block the circulation of air in the first air inlet pipe, the second air inlet pipe is further arranged at the gap between the second partition board and the third partition board, and the electromagnetic valve is further arranged on the inner wall of the second air inlet pipe to control the flowability of the second air inlet pipe, so that a quantitative air inlet is performed on a sample of detected air.

title: Environment engineering detection device
abstract: The invention relates to the field of environmental engineering, in particular to an environmental engineering detection device. The problems to be solved are: the prior art utilizes electrical components to sample work, and the reliability is extremely poor, can't realize sampling a plurality of changeable degree of depth, can't utilize the water of different degree of depth to clean the sample cavity, and the water sample at the water sampling bottom can stir the water bottom impurity, influences sampling data. The technical proposal is as follows: an environmental engineering detection device comprises a sampling box, a lifting closed system, a cleaning sampling system, a stabilizing system and the like; the sampling box is connected with a lifting closed system; the rear part of the sampling box is provided with a clean sampling system; the lower part of the sampling box is connected with a stabilizing system. The lifting closed system provided by the invention can be used for respectively obtaining water samples with different depths according to requirements when the device is used for sampling, so that the problem that only a plurality of water with fixed depths can be sampled and only the sampling device can be replaced when the sampling depth requirements are changed is solved.

title: Crucible access device and full moisture test system
abstract: The utility model belongs to the technical field of sample total moisture measurement, and discloses a crucible access device and a total moisture test system. When the crucible is stored, the crucible is placed at the corresponding placement position from the storage port, and the placement tray is driven to rotate through the driving mechanism, so that the storage port sequentially corresponds to different placement positions, and the crucible is sequentially placed at the placement position; when the crucible is taken out, the placing plate is driven to rotate through the driving mechanism, so that the placing positions sequentially correspond to the taking-out openings, the crucible placed at the placing positions can be rotated to the taking-out opening first, the crucible is placed and taken out sequentially, a certain cooling time can be provided for each crucible, and the crucible temperature is prevented from being too high. Furthermore, each placing plate corresponds to a driving mechanism, so that each placing plate can independently rotate, the placing plates are not mutually influenced, and the crucible is taken out more flexibly.

title: Environment monitoring hydrogeology testing arrangement
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of environmental monitoring and discloses an environmental monitoring hydrogeologic testing device which comprises a base, wherein the front part of the upper end and the rear part of the upper end of the base are fixedly connected with fixing mechanisms in a penetrating way, the four corners of the lower end of the base are fixedly connected with universal wheels, the middle part of the upper end of the base is fixedly connected with a filter box, the lower part of the left end of the filter box is fixedly connected with a storage box, the upper part of the front end of the filter box is fixedly connected with a controller, the right part of the upper end of the base is fixedly connected with a testing groove, and the lower parts of the right groove wall of the testing groove and the lower part of the right groove wall of the filter box are fixedly connected with drain pipes in a penetrating way. According to the environmental monitoring hydrogeology testing device, the fixing mechanism and the ground inserting mechanism are arranged, so that the device can be firmly fixed with the ground, the stability of the device is improved, and the water can be uniformly sprayed on the filter screen by arranging the filter box and the shunt pipe, so that the filtering efficiency is improved, and the device is suitable for wide use.

title: Mixed bead layering arrangement for thermal swing adsorption application
abstract: An adsorbent vessel for removing contaminants from a feed gas upstream from a cryogenic distillation process using pressure swing adsorption, temperature swing adsorption, or thermal-pressure swing adsorption. The adsorbent vessel having an adsorbent bed comprised of multiple layers of adsorbent material, including two layers of adsorbent material that selective adsorbs carbon dioxide. Each of the two layers is formed from an adsorbent material having a different capacity for adsorbing carbon dioxide.

title: Raw material processing apparatus and processing method
abstract: The present invention relates to a technique for treating a raw material such as combustible waste, and more particularly to a technique for combustion, pyrolysis and gasification treatment without releasing carbon dioxide into the atmosphere. The processing device is provided with: a fluidized bed furnace (1) having a pyrolysis chamber (6) and a combustion chamber (7) partitioned by a partition wall (10) inside; an electrolysis device (2) that electrolyzes water to generate hydrogen and oxygen; a methanation reactor (3) that generates methane from hydrogen and carbon dioxide discharged from the combustion chamber (7); a first fluidizing gas supply line (11) which supplies a first fluidizing gas into the pyrolysis chamber (6); and a second fluidizing gas supply line (12) which introduces a portion of the carbon dioxide and oxygen as second fluidizing gases to the combustion chamber (7).

title: Low-density ceramsite propping agent and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of petroleum and natural gas exploitation, and particularly relates to a low-density ceramsite proppant and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method comprises the following steps of S1, calcining oil sludge dry slag at a high temperature for standby, S2, mixing the oil sludge dry slag calcined at the high temperature with titanium-containing blast furnace slag to obtain a mixture, S3, crushing and granulating the mixture obtained in the step S2, sintering in a rotary kiln, and then transferring into a cooling device for quenching to obtain the low-density ceramsite propping agent. According to the preparation method of the low-density ceramsite proppant, the oil sludge dry slag and the titanium-containing blast furnace slag are used as raw materials to prepare the low-density ceramsite proppant, other materials are not doped, so that the waste recycling is realized, and the requirement of the low-density ceramsite proppant for bauxite resources is reduced. In addition, the invention adopts the titanium-containing blast furnace slag to provide titanium as a coagulation core formed by microcrystals, shortens the crystallization time, greatly reduces the time required by sintering and reduces the sintering cost.

title: Method and device for producing round granular large-particle ammonium sulfate
abstract: The invention relates to a method and a device for producing round granular large-particle ammonium sulfate. The device comprises an adsorption unit, a crystallization unit and a separation unit, wherein the crystallization unit comprises a crystallizer, a vapor recompression system, a circulating mother liquor heater and an acid-base regulating unit; the separation unit comprises a thickener and a centrifugal drying part, and the overflow surface at the upper end of the thickener is also connected with the boiling surface of the crystallizer through a pipeline. The present application also provides a method for producing large-particle ammonium sulfate by the above device. The device and the method of the application improve the duty ratio of the ammonium sulfate particles with the diameter of more than or equal to 2.0mm and the yield of large-particle ammonium sulfate while saving the steam consumption.

title: Raw material dissolving tank for germanium purification
abstract: The application discloses a raw material dissolving tank for germanium purification, wherein a corrosion-resistant alloy material layer is laid on the inner wall of a shell layer of a tank body, the corrosion-resistant alloy material layer is utilized to improve the corrosion resistance degree of the tank body to a concentrated hydrochloric acid solution, and meanwhile, the shell layer is connected with the corrosion-resistant alloy material layer and a cover body through a flange, so that the corrosion-resistant alloy material layer can be conveniently replaced according to the corrosion condition; meanwhile, the exhaust pipe is arranged on the top surface of the tank body, acid mist-containing gas generated in the mixing and stirring process is pumped out of the tank body and is introduced into the alkaline solution pool, so that the acid mist-containing gas generated in the raw material dissolving process is effectively neutralized, and the damage of the direct emptying of the acid mist-containing gas to operators around the production environment is reduced. This raw materials dissolving tank can not protect tank body inner wall, avoids direct and concentrated hydrochloric acid solution contact, can also in time change according to the corruption condition on corrosion-resistant alloy material layer simultaneously, effectively reduces dissolving process running cost, reduces the acid mist volume of emptying, realizes effective protection to operating personnel.

title: Conjugated chemical degradation inducers and methods of use
abstract: The subject matter described herein relates to antibody-CIDE conjugates (Ab-CIDE), pharmaceutical compositions comprising them, and their use in treating diseases and conditions in which targeted protein degradation is beneficial.

title: Compounds for inhibiting or degrading target proteins, compositions, comprising the same, methods of their making, and methods of their use
abstract: Provided herein are heterobifunctional compounds which find utility as modulators of targeted ubiquitination. Also provided herein are pharmaceutically acceptable compositions comprising said compounds and methods of using the compounds, and compositions in the treatment of various diseases, conditions, or disorders.

title: Anti-ubiquitinyl oxidase family nanobody or antigen binding fragment and application thereof
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of medical biology, and relates to an anti-lysyl oxidase family nanobody or antigen binding fragment and application thereof. The anti-pan LOX family nano antibody or antigen binding fragment comprises three complementarity determining regions CDR1, CDR2 and CDR3, wherein the amino acid sequence of the CDR1 is shown as one of SEQ ID NO: 1-SEQ ID NO:8, the amino acid sequence of the CDR2 is shown as one of SEQ ID NO: 9-SEQ ID NO:17, and the amino acid sequence of the CDR3 is shown as one of SEQ ID NO: 18-SEQ ID NO: 26. The invention screens the library by using a flow panning method to finally obtain the anti-human/mouse anti-pan LOX family nano antibody gene sequence. The anti-pan-LOX family nano antibody has the advantages of small molecular weight, high affinity and better specificity. Has good prospect for diagnosing fibrosis.

title: Compound radix puerariae, radix scutellariae and coptis chinensis soup, and method and effect thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a compound kudzuvine root, baical skullcap root and coptis root decoction, a method and an effect thereof, 1) a non-alcoholic fatty liver disease mouse model is established, 2) the compound kudzuvine root, baical skullcap root and coptis root decoction is used for treating non-alcoholic fatty liver disease metagenome and metabonomics analysis, 3) the compound kudzuvine root, baical skullcap root and coptis root decoction is used for improving the lipid disorder of the non-alcoholic fatty liver disease through the regulation and control of TGR5 by intestinal flora metabolite 3-phenylpropionic acid, and then a liver cancer cell line lipid deposition model is established; 4) Bacterial outer vesicles can localize to the liver and exert biological effects on non-alcoholic fatty liver disease; the invention discovers that the compound kudzuvine root, baical skullcap root and coptis root soup can improve host NAFLD diseases through AKK bacteria and metabolite 3-phenylpropionic acid; akk the metabolite 3-phenylpropionic acid may improve NAFLD lipid disorders through TGR5 modulation.

title: Enzyme and pathway modulation with sulfhydryl compounds and their derivatives
abstract: The present invention relates to proteins, particularly antibodies such as anti-CD20/anti-CD3 bispecific antibodies and anti α-synuclein antibodies, having monogalactosylated (Gi) and digalactosylated (G2) glycans. More particular, the present invention relates to galactosylation engineering to generate proteins with improved therapeutic properties, including proteins with increased titer. Further, the invention relates to a cell culture medium and a mammalian cell as well as methods using said cell culture medium and said mammalian cell for producing said proteins. Moreover, the present invention relates to the use of said antibodies as a medicament such as for the treatment of cancer, particularly cancer associated with B-cells, or Parkinson's disease.

title: Behavior determination method and device, storage medium and electronic equipment
abstract: The invention discloses a method and a device for determining behaviors, a storage medium and electronic equipment. The method comprises the steps of obtaining historical transaction behavior information of a target object, determining transaction behavior characteristics of the historical transaction behavior of the target object according to the historical transaction behavior information, analyzing the transaction behavior characteristics by using a first model, and determining whether illegal transaction behaviors exist in the historical transaction behaviors corresponding to the transaction behavior characteristics, so that the technical problems of low recognition efficiency and low accuracy of the illegal behaviors in the related art are solved, and the technical effect of improving the behavior recognition efficiency of the target object is achieved.

title: Model-based monitoring data display method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract: The application relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and provides a monitoring data display method and device based on a model, computer equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: responding to a monitoring data viewing request of a user, and verifying the user; if the verification is passed, establishing connection between the called logging module and each monitoring tool, and acquiring monitoring data from the monitoring tools based on the logging module; determining a target abnormity prediction model from a plurality of abnormity prediction models generated by pre-training; carrying out anomaly analysis on each monitoring data based on the target anomaly prediction model to obtain a corresponding anomaly analysis result; performing state labeling on each monitoring data based on the abnormal analysis result to obtain labeled monitoring data; and displaying the marked monitoring data through a preset billboard. The efficiency of acquiring and arranging the monitoring data and the processing efficiency of anomaly analysis can be improved through the method and the device. The method and the device can also be applied to the field of block chains, and the monitoring data can be stored on the block chains.

title: Data processing system, data processing method, program, and data processing integration system
abstract: The present invention solves the problem of providing spatially coordinated items to a user. The data processing system (1) according to the invention comprises an acquisition unit (102) and a generation unit (103). An acquisition unit (102) acquires field investigation data relating to a space. Based on the field survey data, a generation unit (103) changes at least one of a size, a design, and a function represented by item data related to items to be placed in a space to coordinate the items with the space, and generates item processing data for processing items corresponding to the changed item data. The field survey data includes spatially related data relating to a space. A generation unit (103) generates article processing data based on the spatially correlated data.

title: User characteristic generation method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract: The disclosure provides a user characteristic generation method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the fields of big data processing and the like. The specific implementation scheme is as follows: acquiring N pieces of historical behavior data of a target user within a first preset duration; wherein N is an integer greater than or equal to 1; determining topics corresponding to the N pieces of historical behavior data respectively based on the subject words of the M candidate clusters, and aggregating the topics corresponding to the N pieces of historical behavior data respectively to obtain K historical behavior data sets and topics thereof; wherein M and K are integers greater than or equal to 1; determining target behavior data corresponding to the K historical behavior data sets respectively based on center vectors of candidate clusters corresponding to the K historical behavior data sets respectively; and taking the topics and the target behavior data respectively corresponding to the K historical behavior data sets as characteristics of the target user.

title: Setting information utilization system, setting information transition method, information processing apparatus, and program
abstract: To provide a setting information utilization system that prevents a mistake in an application destination of setting information.SOLUTION: An information processing apparatus has a setting information registration unit 32 that registers setting information transmitted from a first electronic apparatus and first identification information for identifying a network that is used when the first electronic apparatus transmits the setting information in association with each other, a specification unit 33 that, in response to an acquisition request for requesting acquisition of the setting information transmitted from a second electronic apparatus, specifies the setting information registered by the setting information registration unit based on the first identification information and second identification information for identifying the network used when the acquisition request is transmitted, and a transmission unit 31b that transmits the setting information specified by the specification unit to the second electronic apparatus.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: Excess material recovery device for machining production line
abstract: The utility model relates to a machining technical field specifically is a machining production line clout recovery unit. The outer sleeve of the rotating rod is sleeved with a fixedly connected linkage sleeve rod, wherein the outer sleeve of the linkage sleeve rod is sleeved with an outer sleeve ring which slides left and right, the outer part of the outer sleeve ring is uniformly provided with fixedly connected crushing cutters, one end of the outer sleeve ring is uniformly provided with fixedly connected side retaining columns, and the inner side of the other end of the outer sleeve ring is provided with a built-in containing groove. Through right the utility model discloses a set up, can restrict aluminium scrap inside the drum, broken sword compares with prior art simultaneously, can remove about removing, like this can the broken scope of the broken sword of effectual increase for aluminium scrap is cut up the efficiency increase of retrieving.

title: Plate shearing machine for plate processing
abstract: The utility model discloses a plate shearing machine for plate processing, which comprises an installation support, a conveying mechanism, a plate cutting mechanism and a driving mechanism, wherein the installation support is fixedly arranged on the plate shearing machine; the conveying mechanism, the plate cutting mechanism and the driving mechanism are all arranged on the mounting bracket; the plate cutting mechanism comprises a plate pressing mechanism, a cutter frame and a connecting plate; the cutter comprises a first cutter and a second cutter; the pressing plate mechanism comprises a connecting bolt, a pressing plate body and a spring; still be provided with the mounting hole on the connecting plate, connecting bolt passes the mounting hole and extends to the below of first cutter, and connecting bolt is provided with the spring with this body coupling of clamp plate in connecting bolt's the outside. Drive the cut trigger through actuating mechanism and reciprocate to the clamp plate body can also reciprocate along with the cut trigger, accomplishes reciprocal extrusion fixed to panel, does not accomplish the fixed to panel at needs manual work, has improved the cutting efficiency of panel, has reduced intensity of labour, has improved the practicality of device.

title: Quick clamping mould for machining stop shaft
abstract: The utility model provides a quick clamping mould for processing a stop shaft, which comprises an accommodating box, a clamping mechanism and an adjusting mechanism; adjustment mechanism includes an electric telescopic handle, the vertical fixed connection of an electric telescopic handle in hold the rear side of box inner chamber one end, hold a terminal surface fixedly connected with fixed cover of box, can follow vertical direction on the fixed cover and vertically be provided with the lifter with sliding. This locking axle processing quick clamping mould, through the cylinder cover behind the surface of locking axle, can drive first grip block and second grip block through the extension of second electric telescopic handle and carry out the centre gripping with the second grip block and fix the locking axle, half first section of thick bamboo board and half section of thick bamboo board of second keep away from each other after the centre gripping, the second motor risees the back, it is rotatory to drive the drum, and then drive locking axle switching direction, after the switching direction, the drum descends, half second section of thick bamboo board and half first section of thick bamboo board are close to each other and are held fixedly again, be convenient for process the locking axle comprehensively.

title: Machining blanking machine material stop gear that stability is strong
abstract: The invention discloses a material limiting mechanism with strong stability for a machining blanking machine, which comprises an adjusting mechanism, a tightening mechanism, a connecting plate, a clamping mechanism and a guide rod, wherein the tightening mechanism for limiting is symmetrically and fixedly connected with the side end face of the connecting plate, and comprises a positioning motor, a positioning plate, a threaded clamping plate, a connecting base, a connecting belt, a first overturning shaft and a threaded shaft. The invention can effectively improve the degree of freedom of the device for grabbing various materials by arranging the adjusting mechanism, the tightening mechanism and the clamping mechanism, so that the adaptability of the device is stronger, the efficiency and the stability for grabbing materials with different shapes are improved, and meanwhile, the adjusting mechanism can quickly adjust the working width between the clamping mechanisms, so that the device has wider distribution of the grabbing width of the material, can adapt to longer and heavier materials, and improves the uniformity and the stability for grabbing the material.

title: Special nut's processing forming device
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field related to metal part machining, in particular to a special nut machining forming device which comprises a base, a feeding seat, a cutting mechanism, a feeding disc, a hole forming mechanism and a material returning mechanism, wherein the bottom surface of the base is provided with supporting legs, the feeding seat is fixed on the base through supporting rods, a section bar to be fed is placed on the feeding seat, the feeding seat is fixedly provided with a feeding positioning mechanism through a mounting bracket, the feeding positioning mechanism is used for forward feeding the section bar, the feeding positioning mechanism is used for positioning the section bar, the base is provided with a mechanical arm, the cutting mechanism is arranged on the mechanical arm, the cutting mechanism is subjected to position adjustment through the mechanical arm, the base is fixedly provided with a motor support, and four blank grooves are uniformly formed in the feeding disc, so that a plurality of steps of section bar cutting, blank hole forming and nut returning are synchronously completed at the positions of each blank groove, and the machining efficiency of equipment is effectively improved.

title: Energy-saving electrical equipment cabinet
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of electrical equipment, in particular to an energy-saving electrical equipment cabinet which comprises a double-layer clamping plate, a top plate, a single-layer plate, a rear plate, a door and a bottom plate, wherein the double-layer clamping plate, the top plate, the single-layer plate, the rear plate, the door and the bottom plate are combined to form an equipment cabinet body; the double-layer clamping plate is divided into an inner plate and an outer plate, the top of one side of the inner plate far away from the outer plate is fixedly connected with a top plate, the bottom of one end of the top plate far away from the inner plate is fixedly connected with a single-layer plate, the top of one side of the single-layer plate close to the inner plate is fixedly connected with a cross beam, the other end of the cross beam is fixedly connected with the inner plate, one end of the double-layer clamping plate is fixedly connected with a rear plate, the other end of the double-layer clamping plate is movably connected with a door, and the bottom of the double-layer clamping plate is fixedly connected with a bottom plate.

title: Connection protection piece, circuit board assembly, power module and electronic equipment
abstract: The application provides a connect protection piece, circuit board subassembly, power module and electronic equipment can be used for cooperating the circuit board and realize the protective effect. The connecting protection piece comprises a protection shell, a protection cap and a fixing ring; the protective shell comprises a bottom plate and a protective plate arranged around the edge of the bottom plate, the bottom plate and the protective plate form an open slot, and the bottom plate is provided with a mounting hole; the protective cap is used for buckling the opening of the open slot to form an accommodating space with the protective shell; the fixing ring is arranged on the protective shell and is provided with a connecting part which extends out of the protective shell from the mounting hole. When the protective device is applied to a scene without electrical connection, the connecting piece can penetrate through the protective shell to fix the circuit board to other structures, and the connecting protective piece shields the connecting piece to play a protective role on the connecting piece; when the connecting protection piece is applied to a scene needing electrical connection, whether the connecting protection piece is electrically connected with other electronic equipment or a circuit board, the connecting protection piece can play a role in protecting part of an electrical connection structure.

title: Electronic device including hinge module
abstract: An electronic device according to an embodiment disclosed herein comprises: a housing that includes a first housing and a second housing configured to pivot relative to the first housing; and a hinge module that is accommodated in the housing and rotatably couples the first housing and the second housing. The hinge module may include: a hinge housing including an accommodation space; a plurality of springs arranged in the accommodation space of the hinge housing; a support member that is coupled to one end of the spring and includes an inclined portion corresponding to the one end of the spring; and a cam that is coupled to the other end of the spring and transmits force to the spring.

title: Protective housing of electronic equipment and electronic equipment
abstract: The application provides a protective shell of electronic equipment and the electronic equipment, wherein the protective shell of the electronic equipment comprises a main body; the bracket is arranged on the main body; the first magnetic conduction piece is arranged on the first side of the bracket, and the second magnetic conduction piece is arranged on the second side of the bracket.

title: Equipment support with buffer structure
abstract: The utility model discloses an equipment support with a buffer structure, and particularly relates to the technical field of equipment supports. When the damping device is used, an operator takes down the sealing cover at the side end of the damping frame, the inner screw sleeve is exposed, the screw sleeve can be rotated by virtue of the holes on the surface of the screw sleeve, the position of the screw sleeve can be adjusted up and down by matching with the threads of the screw rod, the height positions of the screw sleeve are different, and the force of the compression springs is different, so that the elastic adjustment of the springs is realized, the integral buffering protection effect of the device is indirectly adjusted, and the buffering protection performance of the device bracket in use is enhanced.

title: Determining a position of a target ue using assisting ue signaling
abstract: Systems and methods for measuring at and reporting by a target user equipment (UE) of one or more positioning signals sent from one or more assisting UEs to the target UE are disclosed herein. The target UE may receive a positioning signal from an assisting UE according to a communication received at the target UE. The target UE may proceed to perform a positioning measurement using the positioning signal received from the target UE. The positioning measurement may be used by the target UE to estimate its own position, or the positioning measurement may be sent to another entity within a wireless communications system to be used in estimating the physical position of the UE. The handling of multiple received positioning signals from various sources, and the handling of situations where, for example, a transmission reception point (TRP) and an assisting UE may schedule overlapping positioning signals, are also discussed.

title: Positioning co-located user equipment in a vehicle to everything (V2X) environment
abstract: Techniques are provided for determining the position of co-located wireless nodes. An example method for positioning co-located user equipment in a vehicle-to-everything (V2X) environment includes determining a first distance to a first wireless node, sending an indication of a co-located state to a second wireless node based at least in part on the first distance to the first wireless node, receiving a first position estimate based at least in part on radio frequency signal exchanges between the first wireless node and the second wireless node, determine a second distance to the first wireless node, sending an indication of a non-co-located state to the second wireless node based at least in part on the second distance to the first wireless node, and determining a second position estimate based at least in part on radio frequency signal exchanges with the second wireless node.

title: Beam switching method and device based on channel prediction
abstract: The invention discloses a beam switching method and a device based on channel prediction, wherein the method combines an integrated sense of presence (ISAC) technology, and simultaneously introduces a Reconfigurable Intelligent Surface (RIS) to predict channel conditions on the basis of communication and sensing resource sharing so as to make a decision of beam switching. Acquiring state information in a scene of the Internet of vehicles in each time slot; inputting the state information into a reinforcement learning Q value network so as to obtain Q values corresponding to all actions, and outputting the corresponding actions in the current Q value by adopting an epsilon-greedy method; performing an action to obtain a corresponding prize value and status information for a next time slot; storing state information, actions, rewards value of the current time slot and state information of the next time slot in an experience pool; and performing data sampling from the experience pool, and training the reinforcement learning Q value network so as to perform beam switching according to the trained Q value network, thereby improving the stability of the communication link.

title: Techniques for precoding air-to-air sidelink communications
abstract: Methods, systems, and devices for wireless communications are described. A first user equipment (UE) may receive a message indicating geographic location information related to beamforming an air-to-air sidelink message via a sidelink channel. In some examples, a second UE may transmit the message or a base station may transmit the message. The message may be the same or different as a message scheduling the sidelink message. The geographic location information may be geographic location information associated with the second UE, geographic location information associated with one or more directions to avoid when beamforming the sidelink message, or a combination thereof. The first UE may identify one or more precoding parameters based on the geographic location information. The first UE may transmit the air-to-air sidelink message to the second UE. The sidelink message may be precoded for transmission via a transmission beam using the one or more precoding parameters.

title: Signal processing methods and apparatus, terminal and network side device
abstract: The present application belongs to the technical field of communications. Disclosed are signal processing methods and apparatus, a terminal and a network side device. A signal processing method in the embodiments of the present application comprises: a terminal acquires beacon signal configuration information and wake-up signal configuration information configured by different configuration modes; and, according to the beacon signal configuration information and the wake-up signal configuration information, the terminal monitors beacon signals and wake-up signals.

title: Digital printing tectorial membrane rubber coating device
abstract: The utility model discloses a digital printing tectorial membrane rubber coating device, the on-line screen storage device comprises a base, the both sides fixedly connected with support column on base top, the top fixedly connected with roof of support column, the top fixedly connected with processing platform of base, the both sides on processing platform top are provided with the backup pad, two sets of collection boxes have been placed to the inside of processing platform, the both sides fixedly connected with fixed plate of roof bottom, swing joint has the lead screw between the fixed plate, servo motor is installed to one side of fixed plate. This digital printing tectorial membrane rubber coating device passes through the glue spreader and moves the rubber coating on packing cardboard, and the inside of collecting the box can be flowed into along the mesh at processing bench top to unnecessary glue that the rubber coating produced, and processing finishes after will collecting the box again and take out from the processing bench can, and the inside glue of collecting the box can be collected and recycled, and this structure has realized being convenient for collect unnecessary glue, has solved the problem of glue pollution processing environment.

title: High-quality laminating device
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of printing equipment, and particularly relates to a high-quality laminating device which comprises a laminating platform, a printed matter unwinding mechanism arranged at the front end of the laminating platform, a protective film unwinding mechanism arranged above the laminating platform, a product winding mechanism arranged at the tail end of the laminating platform, a laminating mechanism arranged on the laminating platform and used for coating a protective film on a printed matter, a gluing mechanism arranged between the printed matter unwinding mechanism and the laminating mechanism and used for gluing the surface of the printed matter, and a static removing mechanism which is arranged corresponding to the protective film unwinding mechanism and used for removing static on the protective film. The invention provides a high-quality film coating device which can avoid the defects of film coating wrinkles, bubbles, unevenness, infirmity and the like and effectively improve the film coating quality of the device.

title: Paper tensioning and conveying device with paper positioning structure for lithography
abstract: The invention discloses a paper tensioning and conveying device for planographic printing and a paper positioning structure thereof, which comprises a conveying plate, wherein a V-shaped groove is formed in one side of the top end of the conveying plate, an air outlet pipe is fixedly connected to the inner wall of one side of the V-shaped groove, a plurality of air outlet holes are uniformly formed in one side wall of the air outlet pipe, a positioning air box is fixedly embedded in the other side of the top end of the conveying plate, a plurality of air suction holes are uniformly formed in the top end of the positioning air box, a mounting groove is formed in the middle of the bottom end of the conveying plate, and a fan is fixedly mounted in the mounting groove. Thereby positioning the brushed-flat paper sheet on the transfer plate by suction.

title: Glue dripping mark positioning and printing device
abstract: The utility model discloses a glue dripping mark location printing device, including the board, the board has set gradually by preceding to the back along the transmission direction of membrane material: the unwinding roller is used for unwinding the film material; the coating device comprises an anilox roller and a coating tank, wherein the coating tank can contain a coating, and the anilox roller can transfer the coating in the coating tank to one side of a film material; the outer surface of the printing roller is provided with positioning pictures and texts, and the molding rubber roller can press one side of the film material on the outer surface of the printing roller; the printing roller is used for performing register printing on the coating on one side of the membrane material; and the winding roller is used for winding the film material. The printing device is reasonable in layout, the coating in the coating tank is transferred by the anilox roller, the coating with a certain thickness is coated on one side of the membrane material, the positioning pictures and texts are transferred to the coating coated on one side of the membrane material by the printing roller, and then the printing roller is used for sleeve position printing on the coating to form three-dimensional pictures and texts, so that the stereoscopic vision effect of the glue dripping mark can be effectively improved, and the application range is very wide.

title: Substrate encapsulation device and substrate printing equipment using same
abstract: The utility model provides a substrate encapsulation device and substrate printing equipment using the same, wherein the substrate encapsulation device comprises a roller mounting seat, a pair of bearing bases, a bearing pressing plate, a locking piece and a locking piece, wherein the pair of bearing bases are arranged on two sides of the roller mounting seat at intervals, roller mounting grooves are formed in the tops of the bearing bases, the locking piece is arranged on one side of the roller mounting grooves, the bearing pressing plate can be installed on the tops of the bearing bases in a turnover mode, the locking piece is installed on the bearing pressing plate and matched with the locking piece, and when two ends of an encapsulation roller are rotatably installed in the corresponding roller mounting grooves, the bearing pressing plate is turned close to the roller mounting grooves and matched with the locking piece through the locking piece, so that the bearing pressing plate is locked on the bearing base, and the encapsulation roller is sealed between the roller mounting grooves and the bearing pressing plate. The rubber covered roller of the substrate rubber covered device provided by the utility model is convenient to assemble and disassemble and maintain, can correct the position and angle offset of the rubber covered roller relative to a target substrate, and can scrape excessive ink on the surface of the rubber covered roller, thereby improving rubber covered precision.

title: Energy control coatings, structures, devices, and methods of fabrication thereof
abstract: Multilayer metallo-dielectric energy control coatings are disclosed in which one or more layers are formed from a hydrogenated metal nitride dielectric, which may be hydrogenated during or after dielectric deposition. Properties of the multilayer coating may be configured by appropriately tuning the hydrogen concentration (and/or the spatial profile thereof) in one or more hydrogenated metal nitride dielectric layers. One or more metal layers of the multilayer coating may be formed on a hydrogenated nitride dielectric layer, thereby facilitating adhesion of the metal with a low percolation threshold and enabling the formation of thin metal layers that exhibit substantial transparency in the visible spectrum. Optical properties of the coating may be tuned through modulation of metal-dielectric interface roughness and dispersion of metal nanoparticles in the dielectric layer. Electrical busbars and micro-nano electrical grids may be integrated with one or more metal layers to provide functionality such as de-icing and defogging.

title: Area selective deposition of dielectric film on silicon containing surfaces utilizing alcohols
abstract: A method for selectively passivating a surface of a substrate, wherein the surface of the substrate includes at least a first surface comprising silicon nitride and at least a second surface comprising a material other than silicon nitride. The method includes the step of exposing the surface to at least one alcohol wherein the alcohol selectively reacts with the silicon nitride to passivate the first surface thereby leaving the second surface substantially unreacted.

title: Multilayer dielectric substrate and method for manufacturing multilayer dielectric substrate
abstract: A method includes after application of a bonding material, such as a metal paste, on a second dielectric substrate, a first dielectric substrate with a recess formed therein is laminated on the second dielectric substrate. Thereafter, the bonding material is sintered to form a cavity inside the dielectric substrate.

title: Laminated substrate with piezoelectric thin film, piezoelectric thin film element and method for manufacturing this element
abstract: There is provided a laminated substrate with a piezoelectric thin film, comprising: a substrate; an electrode film formed on the substrate; and a piezoelectric thin film formed on the electrode film, wherein the piezoelectric thin film is made of an alkali niobium oxide represented by a composition formula of (K 1−x Na x ) NbO 3 (0<x<1), having a perovskite structure, and oriented preferentially in (001) plane direction, and contains a metallic element selected from a group consisting of Mn and Cu at a concentration of 0.2 at % or more and 0.6 at % or less.

title: Method for forming resist underlayer film and patterning process
abstract: The present invention is a method for forming a resist underlayer film, including: a coating step of coating a substrate with a composition for forming a resist underlayer film containing a metal compound having a metal-oxygen covalent bond and an organic solvent; and a heating step of heating the coated substrate in an atmosphere having an oxygen concentration of less than 1 volume % at a temperature of 450 DEG C or higher and 800 DEG C or lower, where a compound containing at least one crosslinking group represented by the following general formulae (a-1) to (a-4), (b-1) to (b-4), and (c-1) to (c-3) is used as the metal compound. This provides: a method for forming a resist underlayer film that contains metal and that exhibits both high filling property and high dry etching resistance; and a patterning process using the method.

title: Catadioptric image acquisition method and apparatus with minimum occlusion
abstract: The present invention relates to an image acquisition method and apparatus to acquire a wide-area image with minimized occluded areas. According to one embodiment of the present invention, the image acquisition apparatus comprises: a first reflector reflecting light of a first path incident from the outside; a second reflector positioned spaced apart from the front surface of the first reflector to re-reflect the light of the first path reflected from the first reflector to be incident into a first hole at a vertex of the first reflector; and an image sensor installed on the rear surface of the first reflector to convert the light of the first path and the light of the second path incident from the outside into electrical signals. The second reflector includes a concave lens installed in the hole of the second reflector to allow the light of the second path to pass through and reach the image sensor installed on the rear surface of the first reflector.

title: Imaging device and electronic apparatus
abstract: Provided is an imaging device that reduces the influence of light-collection misalignment even when there are variations in the position or the like of an on-chip lens for pixels. An imaging device of the present disclosure comprises a plurality of pixels and an on-chip lens. The pixels of the imaging device perform photoelectric conversion of incident light from a subject to generate an image signal.
