The on-chip lens of the imaging device is disposed commonly for the plurality of pixels, has a non-light-collecting region in a central portion thereof, and collects, through a peripheral portion thereof, the incident light onto the plurality of pixels.

title: Panoramic single-pixel imaging device and method
abstract: The invention discloses a panoramic single-pixel imaging device and a method, comprising a digital projector for projecting a target object, a plane mirror group for carrying out back reflection on the target object, a first photoelectric detector for detecting the light intensity value in front of the target object, a second photoelectric detector for detecting the light intensity value in back of the target object, a digital signal acquisition device for acquiring the light intensity values acquired by the first photoelectric detector and the second photoelectric detector, and a computer for image generation and single-pixel image restoration; the digital projector is arranged in front of the target object, the plane mirror group is arranged on the back of the target object, and the output ends of the first photoelectric detector and the second photoelectric detector are connected to the digital signal acquisition device; the front and rear of the target object in the panoramic single-pixel imaging device are respectively provided with a photoelectric detector, and the photoelectric detectors are combined with the digital signal acquisition device, the digital projector and the plane mirror group to achieve synchronous projection and realize automatic synchronous imaging.

title: Video projection apparatus
abstract: An object of the present invention is to provide a video projection apparatus capable of obtaining a satisfactory video (image) while achieving reduction in power consumption and size of the apparatus. There is provided a video projection apparatus equipped with at least a monolithic semiconductor laser array having a plurality of light emitting units that respectively emit laser light, an optical waveguide that guides the laser light in a predetermined direction, a mirror that performs scanning with the laser light on two axes, and a diffraction element that diffracts the laser beam in a specific direction in front of an eye and projects the laser beam onto a retina, each of the plurality of light emitting units being optically coupled to a mutually different one of a plurality of incident ports of the optical waveguide.

title: Image display device
abstract: An image display device includes: an imaging element; a light source configured to irradiate light toward the imaging element; an optical system located in an optical path between the imaging element and the light source; a light-shielding member configured to shield a portion of light of at least the light source; and a light-transmitting member configured to transmit light emitted from the imaging element.

title: Fork truck davit connecting device
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of connection of forklift auxiliary devices, and discloses a forklift suspension arm connecting device, which comprises an integral device, wherein the integral device comprises a forklift, the forklift back surface is symmetrically provided with forklift arms at the left and right sides, the back surface of the integral device is provided with a connecting device, a clamping device is arranged in the suspension arm connecting device, the connecting device comprises a connecting bridge, the lower surface of the connecting bridge is fixedly connected with two rectangular sleeves, the inner sides of the two rectangular sleeves are movably sleeved on the upper and lower surfaces of the forklift arms, a suspension arm socket is arranged in the middle of the back surface of the connecting bridge, part of the structure at the lower end of a U-shaped rod moves upwards to enable two cylindrical blocks to move upwards through two openings, and, the upper surface of the second wedge block is matched with the lower surface of the forklift arm more through the upward movement of the second wedge block, so that the effect of enabling the connecting device to be more stable in connection is achieved.

title: Vertical electric tail plate
abstract: The invention discloses a vertical electric tail plate, which belongs to the technical field of truck lifting tail plates and structurally comprises a lifting assembly, a lower door assembly, a left inner column, a left outer column, an upper door sliding block, an upper door connecting rod, an upper door hinge support, a motor, a speed reducer, a gear box, an upper cross beam, an upper door assembly, a right inner column, a right outer column, a screw rod lower support bearing assembly, a lifting nut assembly, a screw rod, a lower door opening and closing rope, a lower door opening and closing nut assembly, an upper door opening and closing rope, an upper door opening and closing nut assembly, a lifting ring, a screw rod upper support bearing assembly and a stop ring. The invention discloses a novel vertical electric tail plate, which utilizes a screw rod transmission mechanism to respectively control lifting of a lower door, opening and closing of the lower door and opening and closing of an upper door through up-down operation of three nuts on the screw rod, wherein the lifting movement of the lower door is realized by driving the lower door component through a lifting component by a lifting nut component, the opening and closing movement of the lower door is realized by connecting the lower door opening and closing nut component to the lower door component through a rope, and the opening and closing movement of the upper door is realized by connecting the upper door opening and closing nut component to the upper door component through a rope. The invention has an external stop ring structure, and can manually control the opening and closing of the upper door. The beneficial effects of the invention are as follows: the full-electric control and auxiliary manual control system is adopted, the operation is simple, the self-locking performance is good, the safety is high, the service life is long, the transmission is stable, the noise is low, and the compatibility with a truck is good.

title: Heavy load balance driving device for vertical shaft
abstract: The invention discloses a heavy load balance driving device for a vertical shaft, which comprises a fixed upright post and a movable upright post, wherein the middle parts of the fixed upright post and the movable upright post are respectively provided with an inner cavity; a driving device capable of driving the movable upright post to move along the inner cavity of the fixed upright post is fixedly arranged between the inner cavity of the fixed upright post and the inner cavity of the movable upright post; a buffer mechanism which can provide motion resistance for offsetting the gravity of the movable upright post is fixedly arranged between the inner cavity of the fixed upright post and the inner cavity of the movable upright post. The heavy load balance driving device for the vertical shaft disclosed by the invention solves the problems that the main driving of the existing heavy load vertical shaft driving device is difficult to select types and bears heavy load, and the service life of the main driving is shortened.

title: Hoisting mechanical linking device
abstract: The utility model discloses a hoisting mechanical linking device applied to the field of transportation apparatuses, which comprises a supporting transverse plate, wherein both sides of the supporting transverse plate are fixedly connected with horizontal guide rails, one side of the upper surface of the supporting transverse plate is fixedly provided with a servo motor, the output end of the servo motor is in transmission connection with a driving screw rod, the utility model ensures that the driving force required by the transportation assembly during transportation is lower by arranging a transportation pulley in the horizontal guide rails, and the driving screw rod is driven to rotate by the servo motor, the driving sliding block can be driven to displace, so that the driving transverse plate is driven to displace under the driving of the driving sliding block, the lifting assembly is horizontally transported through the U-shaped connecting plate, the driving force required by the servo motor during transportation of the transporting assembly can be reduced through the horizontal guide rail, energy is saved, and the problems that the guide structure adopted in the horizontal transportation of the common horizontal crane generally adopts the mounting plate to directly slide on the guide plate, the energy loss is large, the required consumed electric quantity is more and the economical efficiency is poor are solved.

title: Chassis suspension mechanism, chassis and robot
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of machinery, especially, relate to a chassis hangs mechanism, chassis and robot. The chassis suspension mechanism includes: the swing rod is used for mounting a wheel; the bracket is connected to the swing rod and is used for being connected with the chassis body; the swing rod can vibrate up and down relative to the bracket; and the vibration damping assembly comprises a vibration damping piece, the vibration damping piece stretches across two ends of the swing rod, and the two ends of the swing rod are connected to two ends of the vibration damping piece in a swinging mode. The utility model discloses in through spaning the damping member in the both ends of pendulum rod, the both ends of pendulum rod can shake respectively and connect in the both ends of damping member with swinging, and the damping member guarantees the buffer capacity to the unevenness road surface, but the fully absorption road surface lasts the vibration energy that gives the chassis again, avoids resonant emergence. The chassis can be effectively ensured to run stably, and larger noise can not be generated.

title: Antistatic clothing cloth and processing technology thereof
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of textile material processing and discloses an antistatic clothing cloth and a processing technology thereof, wherein the processing technology comprises the following steps of firstly preparing a special-shaped fiber, carrying out melt spinning on a polyester slice, extruding the polyester slice by adopting a trilobal spinneret plate, wherein the monofilament cross section is of a ridge structure symmetrically distributed at 120 ℃, the height-groove depth ratio is 1:1.8-2.2, secondly, carrying out graded drafting, namely carrying out three-stage gradient drafting in a spinning channel, wherein the primary drafting ratio is 2.5-3.0 (the temperature is 80-90 ℃), the secondary drafting ratio is 1.8-2.2 (the temperature is 100-110 ℃), the tertiary drafting ratio is 1.2-1.5 (the temperature is 60-70 ℃), and on the antistatic performance, the surface resistance can be as low as 5.5X10 8 Ω/sq, the electrostatic pressure half life is as low as 0.5s as possible, and the electrostatic pressure half life is far superior to the prior art, and the safe requirements in the fields of electronics, chemical industry and the like can be rapidly dissipated.

title: Intelligent vending machine convenient to remove
abstract: The utility model discloses an intelligent vending machine convenient to move, which comprises a vending machine body and rollers; the gyro wheel rotates through the shaft and is connected with and holds the case, and the gyro wheel is equipped with the card solid device, and the card solid device sets up the joint piece in the gyro wheel outside including the symmetry. The utility model realizes the clamping and fixing of the roller and the convenient separation at the same time by arranging the rotatable clamping block, realizes the clamping and releasing of the roller, and further improves the stability and the mobility of the vending machine; through being equipped with drive gear and worm gear, conveniently carry out the regulation of joint piece.

title: Method and device for merging flight operation data, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention discloses a method and a device for combining flight operation data, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The invention relates to the technical field of aviation operation. The method comprises the following steps: establishing a flight plan and dynamic information storage table; receiving and analyzing the SITA format message, acquiring flight operation time data in the SITA format message, and updating the flight plan and dynamic information storage table according to the flight operation time data in the SITA format message; and receiving and analyzing an AFTN format message, acquiring flight operation time data in the AFTN format message, and updating the flight plan and dynamic information storage table according to the flight operation time data in the AFTN format message. The problem that the airport is singly dependent on SITA format messages or AFTN format messages and the completeness and the accuracy of flight operation data are difficult to guarantee is solved, the defect that flight operation data only depend on one format message is overcome by combining the flight operation data, and the completeness and the accuracy of the flight operation data are guaranteed.

title: Hydraulic piston assembly
abstract: A piston assembly for a transmission includes a piston and a washer connected to the piston. In one embodiment, the washer includes a circumferential ring that extends continuously about an inner diameter, wherein a cavity is defined between the piston and the washer. A bearing element is retained and centered on the washer by the circumferential ring.

title: A tongue-and-groove module, arrangement structure, cavity structure for prefabricated component preparation
abstract: The utility model discloses a mortise module, an arrangement structure and a cavity structure for manufacturing prefabricated parts, wherein the mortise module comprises a main body; the main body is provided with a mortise; one side of the main body, which is away from the mortise, is provided with a fixing part for clamping the prefabricated member reinforcing steel bars. The arrangement structure comprises a core mold of the prefabricated component mold and a plurality of mortice modules arranged on the surface of the core mold, so that after pouring of the prefabricated component mold is completed, the main body of the mortice modules forms mortises in the thickness direction of the inner wall of the cavity formed by the core mold. After the prefabricated component cavity is poured, new concrete enters the mortise after entering the prefabricated component cavity, the new concrete is combined with the old concrete to form a mortise structure, the structure can effectively disperse structural stress in all directions during earthquake waves, the concrete is not easy to slip when being subjected to upward subversion force, the new concrete and the old concrete are not easy to delaminate and split when being pressed downwards, and the integrity of a neutralization shaft is ensured when the concrete shakes left and right, and the feather flushing is not needed.
